findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-triggered-gate-mode-default-decision.md line 69 (Verification section) claims a regression test pins resolveDoneGateMode/config default to observe when unset, but no such function resolveDoneGateMode exists anywhere in the codebase (the real function is configuredProofStoryMode in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:142-144), and no test in the diff or existing suite exercises the config-key-absent fallback path. All doneGateMode references added to packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs (lines 1650, 1815, 2274) explicitly set doneGateMode: observe in the fixture config rather than testing the unset/default-fallback behavior. The promised regression test for the default itself does not exist.

Dead code: packages/main/src/tasks/milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke.ts lines 59-60 compute smokeName via resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), name) and immediately discard it with void smokeName on the next line. The variable is never referenced again anywhere else in the file (grep confirms only these two lines mention smokeName). This differs from the established convention in other tasks slash star-smoke.ts files, where the analogous packageRoot constant is actually used later (e.g. in execSync calls). Here it is pure dead code that should be deleted.

doc-code-drift: milestone-triggered-gate-mode-default-decision.md Verification section (line 69) claims A regression test pins `resolveDoneGateMode`/config default to `observe` when unset but no function, export, or symbol named resolveDoneGateMode exists anywhere in the codebase (grep across packages/ and docs/ returns zero hits besides this doc). The actual resolver is configuredProofStoryMode in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts (loadConfig(ctx.root).proofStory?.[key] ?? observe). There is also no dedicated named regression test/smoke file for this default; CHK-009 verification used ad-hoc scratch node harnesses recorded as verificationEvidence, not a committed named test the doc could point a reader to. The doc should name the real resolver (configuredProofStoryMode) or drop the fabricated function name so a future reader can locate the cited guard.
